text:
Situation: Piperacillin sodium and tazobactam sodium is in short supply. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC appears on the FDA shortage list with status To Be Discontinued, initial posting 2026-01-20, citing discontinuation of manufacture. Current inventory across Corvale sites provides 18 to 24 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1286862 of Aurobindo Pharma Limited (FEI 3004446312), a registered manufacturing plant for NDC 55150-0119-09, ended on 2025-09-05 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2025-12-04. The same label names Eugia SEZ Private Limited (FEI 3011905047) as a registered plant for analysis, manufacture, and pack, last inspected VAI on 2019-03-01. A second label (NDC 83634-0112-99) names ACS DOBFAR SPA as a sponsor-only manufacturing site.

Our position: Supply is limited to 18–24 days across sites. Fresenius Kabi has discontinued manufacture. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list today, but their labels name no plants we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Apotex Corp., Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., B. Braun Medical Inc., Baxter Healthcare Corporation, and BluePoint Laboratories as alternate sources; P&T Committee to approve formulary additions.
2. Buyer to initiate emergency purchase orders for qualified alternates; Pharmacy Director to approve expenditure.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for status changes; Supply Chain Manager to approve allocation protocols if needed.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing or therapeutic substitution recommendations; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
